_comment: File ownership per rebuild ticket. Derived from an actual failure: tickets 1 and 3
independently implemented v2 retryable backpressure with incompatible APIs, because
nothing declared who owned live_service_runtime.py. An agent that touches a path it
'owns' is a list of path prefixes the ticket may create or modify.
'reads' is advisory only and is not enforced.

r1-reference-ui.title: Port the reference frontend for real

r2-capture-client.title: Browser capture client and server-fused capture health
r2-capture-client._integration_note: Owns the live_transport.py call site so it can wire project_live_capture_status. Ticket 3's dispatcher work in live_service_runtime.py is parked, so there is no contention. Frontend App integration remains r1's; r2 exports a client for r1 to mount.

r3-dispatcher.title: Bounded inference dispatcher, measured
r3-dispatcher._parked: PARKED 2026-08-14: ga0-alienware-rtx4070ti reports 1125 MiB free -- production vLLM holds the GPU, a second model instance cannot fit, and the charter forbids touching the running services. Concurrency is a scale concern, not an MVP blocker. Unpark when the GPU is free or an operator authorizes measuring against the existing moss-vllm endpoint.
